Phase 3's verification note #1 was lost to a literal '@/tmp/bead_note.txt' argument, so I re-verified that phase by hand: module docs name capture/, 22 files, all <=1500. Epic-caused defect fixed while landing: bob-cli-2f.10 re-exported every pub(crate) item from capture_pomodoro_close/mod.rs, which left 3 new unused_imports warnings (10 names). Those broke the plan's no-new-warnings rule, so I narrowed the re-exports to the 16 names callers actually use; tests import through submodule paths. The one conflict is that bob-cli-28's never-committed closeout plan cites tests/cli.rs, which this epic removed; I recorded the new path on bob-cli-28. Step 3 (follow-ups): (a) the '|| true' overly_complex_bool_expr deny at tests/cli/capture/pomodoro_name.rs:808 (proposed by .1/.4/.5/.6/.7/.8/.9/.10) predates the epic (22abed4, bob-cli-28.1) and is causally owned by active epic bob-cli-28, so I added a DISCOVERED ISSUE note there and filed no task. (b) The 17 pre-existing clippy warnings (proposed by .6/.7) duplicate bob-cli-v, so I added a +1 with the post-split locations. (c) The capture_pomodoro_close unused re-exports (proposed by .10) were caused by the epic and are fixed in this landing, so no task was filed.
